dimensions.assessment: Applies to taxpayers who experience lost or stolen federal tax refund paper checks and qualify for replacements.
dimensions.evidence: taxpayers, which are otherwise eligible to receive an amount by paper check in replacement of a lost or stolen paper check

dimensions.assessment: Provides an administrative and procedural alternative for receiving existing refund amounts electronically.
dimensions.evidence: elect to receive such amount by direct deposit in lieu of receiving such replacement paper check

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue changes are stated in the source.
Requires the Treasury Department to issue regulations and establish new operational procedures within six months.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than the date which is 6 months after the date of the enactment of this subsection, the Secretary shall prescribe regulations to establish procedures

dimensions.assessment: Creates a permanent amendment to the Internal Revenue Code with nationwide availability.

missing_information: Estimated number of taxpayers affected annually
Administrative cost to establish the direct deposit procedures
importance_detail.rationale: This bill requires the Treasury to create procedures allowing eligible taxpayers to receive replacement federal tax refunds via direct deposit instead of paper checks if their original check was lost or stolen.
